It’s almost November and it’s one of our favorite times of year. Whooping cranes arrive in their migration. We are excited for this and plan for it. There was a time when whooping cranes wouldn't come to TX and now they are here. We decide not to live in suburbs, gave that over to the prairies and cranes came back. Bayous, bays and oceans – we are very invested in them being protected and clean. We shoo away encroachers. We don’t have cars anymore – long walks and bike rides, except during the crane migration. Content: The ocean is thriving, an abundance of sea life and natural resources. The ocean has gained back its power. We realized the earth starts at the sea and knowing this, we reversed the impacts of climate change. The world has become fully sustainable: communities tend to their gardens, and eco-friendly resources for our food have reduced the destruction of the forests. We fully reduced carbon emissions by driving eco-cars. The ancestors understood that everything needed care and everything that must have been done they did. We took accountability for our careless actions and though it took time, we as a world came together, settled our differences, and realized this is our only earth and we could only save it if we came together. We finally put down our phones and engaged in real life conversations and lived through our eyes and not a screen. From all of those changes, there are no longer endangered species, though our polar bears are no longer with us. Our oceans are flourishing with an abundance of sea life, our forests have never been healthier, our savannas are filled with wildlife and our ice caps are growing. The world is green, the air feels cleaner. The world is finally the world again.

Our ways of life and our practices are guided by the rhythms of nature, in partnership and reciprocity with the earth, its beings, and each other.

We understand that nature is the creation of life.  That it is beautiful, protects life, and heals.  It reminds us to love – not only ones we know, but everyone and everything around us.  I imagine a world so lush and beautiful it connects all energies around.  It feeds and nourishes souls and bellies.  It brings happiness and joy, laughter and memories.  Light and warmth.  Peace and love.  Safety and protection.

The earth is clean, water is drinkable, air gives us life. We coexist with wildlife through restoring and maintaining and enforcing the preservation of wildlife habitat. They exist there and we exist here. Humans have normalized not invading wildlife spaces. The environment will be able to flourish in fresh air and trees.  As they always say, “mother nature will take over,” and I pray she does.  Hopefully the land will be able to grow and people will stop destroying it.

Bodies of water, living organisms have rights – spiritual protection and community councils to govern ecosystems. A world where Mother Earth receives more health and healing as well. We will not create a “perfect” world, and that should not stop us from trying.
The future is simple, it is peaceful. I can see the horizon, with trees and land. We live off the land. The land can heal itself, and with luck, we can heal ourselves with it.
Original of Translation: El futuro es sencillo, es tranquilo. Puedo ver el horizonte, con árboles y tierra. Vivimoss de la tierra. La tierra puede sanarse y con suerte nosotros podemos sanarnos con ella.

Content: I imagined the sun that gives us light, the clouds when it rains, the environmental aspect—trees, pines, flowers heal us in our soul. In the home is the family—we must receive love and respect.
Original of Translation: Me imagine el xol que nos da la luz, las nubes cuando llueve, el medioambiental-árboles, pinos, flores nos sana en el alma.

Content: There are rivers of very clear and transparent water where beautiful stones of many light blue colors can be seen at the bottom. The sea and the sky seem to merge. There is a lot of vegetation with giant trees.
Original of Translation: Hay ríos de agua muy clara y transparente que al fondo se puede ver piedras hermosas de muchos colores celestes. El mar y el cielo parecen juntarse. Hay mucha vegetación con árboles gigantes.

Content: With the scent of plants and air, I embrace the trees and cry.
Original of Translation: Con el aroma de plantas y aire, me abrazo de los árboles y lloro.

Content: Bodies of water are clean and abundant with life.

Year 2176, you are 150 years into the future.  I truly wished I had better news for you, but sadly that’s not the case.  Before I go any further, I want to tell you that a lot of great groups of worries around the world fought very hard for a beautiful, bright future.  In 2176, most of the world is dry, humid, and extremely hot.  We have lost a lot of our green land.

Reimagining.  We have the power to change.  Interconnected globally. Community (global).  Non-monetized.  Clear air, food that is organic.  Clean H20.  Everyone has their basic needs met.  While peaceful, we are protected!  Science based community globally.  Clean energy sources are primary.  Earth is allowed to heal.
The physical environment is managed to sustain life for both human, animal and plant.
Water rights. Air.

We practiced introspection and interdependence. We rely on each other. This includes having care for each other, people, animals, and the places and land around us. Land is not something to be owned but something to co-exist with and cultivate. This way of being feels like a beautiful song, written by someone you Love.
The world environment is improving, clean air, water that people would enjoy.
No need of money to live and survive. Exchanges of resources. Clean river/abundance/plants, trees everywhere! Plenty of butterflies, dragonflies, and fireflies!

Date/Circle Name: 8/18/26 A New Way of Life Los Angeles
Content: Environmentally healthy.
All of the world’s continents become one land mass again.
Lot of land for people to enjoy and give back to the land by watering it, caring and most of all loving the land.

Oh, would you look at that, it’s almost time to hear the young people share their stories. We should go and listen. Meanwhile, the crows fly diagonally across the sky on their daily migration. Chatting with each other like the people below. Maybe they also enjoy orange and pink clouds at sunset like you. Maybe a breath of fresh air feels just as good. Maybe food isn't a worry for them either.
We take care of the land: when we see trash, we pick it up, and we don't litter on the ground so the earth stays clean.
Original of Translation: Cuidamos la tierra cuando vemos basura la levantamos y no tirar basura en el pisal para que esté la tierra limpia.

Content: The plants in Martinez were converted for natural energy, and the natural habitats that used to be there were restored.
Original of Translation: Las plantas de Martinez se convirtieron para la energía natural y se restablecieron los hogares naturales que antes estaban ahí.

Content: We humans plant trees and teach our children the importance of taking care of nature.
The air can be breathed clean and pure.
Original of Translation: El aire se puede respirar limpio y puro.

Content: We care for the forests by watering them and making sure there is no trash.
Original of Translation: Los bosque los cuidamos regandolos y cuidando que no haiga basura.

Content: We all have a plot of land to care for.
Original of Translation: Todos tenemos una parte de terreno pra cuidar.

Content: In this green world, it’s not too hot, it’s not too cold.

A world for future generations
A sustainable environment where there’s justice and peace, and where nature and humanity prosper in harmony
A safe environment

Protect and care for the earth
Build a peaceful world

You walk freely feet touching the ground, feeling the warmth of the sun setting on the ground. You feel the cold tickly, refreshing grass. The energy in the earth’s surface feels like light, moving on a time that feels endless. When you put your feet on the ground you remember life is big, life is warm, life is beautiful. You start to feel in tune with nature.
No fancy clothes/shoes. We walk barefoot to be one with the land. We are grounded. Outside = Happiness
lush, green gardens and the sound of rushing water nearby if you listen closely

And in the future, humans will be friendly with nature and befriend forests and mountains. Animals will know how to speak while humans will also understand the sound of birds singing, dogs barking, cats meowing.
